data.description:
## What / Why

Create the GHA workflow file that automates calibration data collection. PR-merge events invoke mutation-append + churn-append via calibration-report.sh. Monthly/quarterly cron triggers invoke the monthly and quarterly aggregation passes. The workflow declares a single UTC timezone constant shared with calibration-report.sh (via --print-timezone or equivalent) so bucket boundaries cannot drift. Includes CI dry-run step that posts a test-shaped comment and asserts the shape matches. Exits non-zero (not silent skip) when calibration-report.sh exits non-zero or when any tracking ticket (calibration-program-health, mutation-history, suite-churn-history) is missing — error message names which ticket is missing and how to create it (run dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh).

## Files to Modify / Create

- .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml — CREATE: on: [push to main (for PR-merge), schedule: cron monthly + quarterly]; jobs: pr-metrics (mutation-append + churn-append), aggregation (monthly/quarterly); fail-fast with named-ticket error; includes dry-run job with comment-shape assertion
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-rollup-workflow.sh — CREATE: validates YAML structure (on.push.branches=[main], on.schedule present, jobs.pr-metrics.steps include mutation-append and churn-append calls); validates error message contains ticket name and bootstrap script name; no live GHA execution required — structural assertions only

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-1: calibration-rollup.yml runs mutation-append and churn-append on PR-merge events
- dd-2: calibration-rollup.yml runs monthly and quarterly on cron triggers using a single declared UTC timezone matching calibration-report.sh bucket boundaries
- dd-3: calibration-rollup.yml CI dry-run posts expected comment shape to test ticket and asserts shape matches
- dd-4: calibration-rollup.yml exits non-zero when calibration-report.sh fails or tracking ticket missing

## Given / When / Then (test approach)

Given .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml exists
When test checks on.push.branches and on.schedule sections
Then both triggers present; on.push matches [main]; on.schedule has two cron entries (monthly, quarterly)

Given workflow file exists
When test checks job step commands for pr-metrics job
Then mutation-append and churn-append both appear as step run commands

Given calibration-report.sh missing a tracking ticket
When workflow invokes calibration-report.sh
Then exit code non-zero and stderr contains 'calibration-program-health' or 'mutation-history' or 'suite-churn-history' AND 'dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh'

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: YAML has on.push.branches=[main] and on.schedule with 2 cron entries
- AC2: pr-metrics job calls mutation-append and churn-append
- AC3: aggregation job calls monthly and quarterly with correct schedule matching
- AC4: Single UTC timezone source (not hardcoded '0 0 1 * *' with no comment — must reference calibration-report.sh's --print-timezone or declare named constant)
- AC5: Exit non-zero + actionable error when tracking ticket missing (names the ticket + bootstrap script)
- AC6: Dry-run job present with comment-shape assertion step
- AC7: Structural test validates AC1-AC6 without live GHA execution

## Testing Mode

RED — .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml does not yet exist

## Retry Budget

3
